body.content: Hi John, I recently left my job at TechCorp and have about $50,000 in my old 401k plan. I'm not sure what to do with it—should I roll it over into an IRA or leave it where it is? I'd appreciate your advice.

Hi Debra, thanks for reaching out. Rolling over your 401k into an IRA often gives you more investment options and lower fees. I'd recommend we set up a traditional IRA to keep the tax benefits. Would you like to schedule a call this week to discuss the details?

From: Debra Williams <debra.williams@example.com>
Sent: 2026-07-23T18:45:40.236012Z
To: John Advisor
Subject: 401k Rollover Inquiry

Hi John, I recently left my job at TechCorp and have about $50,000 in my old 401k plan. I'm not sure what to do with it—should I roll it over into an IRA or leave it where it is? I'd appreciate your advice.

That sounds good, John. I'm free on Thursday afternoon around 2 PM. Can we talk then? Also, are there any tax implications I should be aware of if I do the rollover?

Sent: 2026-07-23T22:45:40.236012Z
To: Debra Williams
Subject: Re: 401k Rollover Inquiry

Hi Debra, thanks for reaching out. Rolling over your 401k into an IRA often gives you more investment options and lower fees. I'd recommend we set up a traditional IRA to keep the tax benefits. Would you like to schedule a call this week to discuss the details?
